decisions.reason: The portable reference-class electrometer sits close to the firm's core dosimetry offer and was featured on the home page in 2023, so it costs little to keep and its value is still unfolding in a growing market with long hardware life cycles.

The oncology risk management software extends the firm's integration and patient-safety strategy, was given its own page, and adoption in clinics is slow and still uncertain, so keeping this cheap-to-maintain software option open is preferable to abandoning it after one year.
